concerns.text: FR-011 requires a sensitivity analysis on a subset (n=100) using an independent ground-truth re-labeling protocol. The plan.md 'Research' and 'Statistical Analysis Plan' sections describe the main pipeline (LLM vs Static Analyzer, Logistic Regression) but contain NO mention of a sensitivity analysis, a secondary labeling protocol, or a subset of n=100 for validation. This FR is silent in the plan.

SC-002 requires measuring if the Logistic Regression adjusted R² is > 0.10 or p < 0.05. While the plan mentions fitting a Logistic Regression, it does not explicitly state that the *threshold* of 0.10 or the specific p-value target will be measured/evaluated as a success criterion. The plan focuses on the *method* (fitting) but misses the *measurement target* defined in the spec.

FR-004 requires computing embedding-based similarity to known vulnerable patterns derived from an 'external, fixed reference set (e.g., a separate CVE corpus)'. The plan.md 'Feature Extraction Strategy' mentions using 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2' and comparing against a 'fixed reference set of known vulnerable patterns (CVE corpus)', but it does not specify *which* CVE corpus or how this reference set is constructed/fetched. The plan is vague on the 'external, fixed reference set' requirement, risking implementation ambiguity.
